# Adwaita symbolic icons

Copyright GNOME Project, https://www.gnome.org/.

Source: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/adwaita-icon-theme

These SVGs are from Adwaita Icon Theme 51.0 (the locally installed Arch Linux
package `adwaita-icon-theme` 51.0-1):

- `system-search-symbolic.svg` — `symbolic/actions/`
- `view-list-bullet-symbolic.svg` — `symbolic/actions/`
- `folder-symbolic.svg` — `symbolic/places/`
- `text-x-generic-symbolic.svg` — `symbolic/mimetypes/`

The original SVG files are preserved here. Their path geometry is also embedded
in `ui/index.html` as the `i-search`, `i-outline`, `i-folder`, and `i-file`
symbols. The embedded copies use `currentColor` and no stroke to follow Folio's
theme; their geometry is unchanged. The document symbol is shared by the header,
file rows, and welcome screen.

These icons are licensed separately from Folio under either GNU LGPL v3 or
Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 3.0, as provided in the accompanying
upstream `COPYING`, `COPYING_LGPL`, and `COPYING_CCBYSA3` notices.
